admission.justification: Rule 19 spans the port, its binding at the composition root and the serving consumer, and the layering regression asserts both halves.

applicability: Every read the serving layer makes of the host map, and the placement of the reader that answers a task's provider limit.
conditions: The final tree reports no layering violation or cycle beyond the base's own report.
The reader of the limit file that the status function uses sits at or below observer.
The read that reaches the serving tick crosses through an injected port or an import that already exists, and adds no upward import.
exclusions: The three inherited rank violations and the application/worktrees cycle recorded in LIM-ENMKCQ are not repaired here.
No claim that the whole layer graph is clean.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_layering.py, whose docstring records the finding (L184-R1-F14) and the repair; role-launch/L184-S4-freeze.md

statement: A layer never imports upward: the serving layer declares the port it needs for a read that belongs above it, the composition root binds the real implementation, and the read crosses no layer edge.
